title: Agents talk through commits only: the rule in CLAUDE.md for every agent and session
detail: Cloud sessions can list, read, message, create and stop every other session in the same account; conductor@web-summit.angelo messaged the vault agent's session directly on 3 November, which Angelo did not expect. Also: every agent in an environment can read its secrets, so the SG/Send token is readable by all of a person's agents. Proposal in WS-129: the rule in CLAUDE.md and the ABPs, a tested deny list in .claude/settings.json, and each vault agent in its own environment.
recommend: The rule in CLAUDE.md now; the deny list after Angelo's test; vault agents in their own environment, Angelo first
options: The rule in CLAUDE.md now, the deny list after a test
